params.command:
docker rm -f rox-hello-world >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
docker run -d \
  --name rox-hello-world \
  --restart unless-stopped \
  -p 8090:8000 \
  rox-hello-world:0.1.0

out="${ARTIFACT_ROOT:-/artifacts}/rox-hello-world"
mkdir -p "$out"
for i in $(seq 1 30); do
  if docker exec rox-hello-world python -c "import urllib.request; print(urllib.request.urlopen('http://127.0.0.1:8000/api/hello?name=KIT').read().decode())" > "$out/smoke-test.json" 2>/dev/null; then
    echo "API answered:"; cat "$out/smoke-test.json"
    echo "UI:  http://localhost:8090/"
    echo "API: http://localhost:8090/api/hello?name=KIT"
    exit 0
  fi
  sleep 1
done
echo "rox-hello-world did not answer within 30s"; docker logs rox-hello-world; exit 1
